input.command:
cat > /root/entrainment_gated_ft/download_models.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
source /etc/network_turbo
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

LOG="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/download_models.log"
echo "=== DOWNLOAD START $(date) ===" > "$LOG"

for ARCH in DeltaNet HGRN; do
  REPO="m-a-p/340M-20B-${ARCH}-hybrid-3-1"
  LOCAL="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/models/340M-20B-${ARCH}-hybrid-3-1"
  echo "Downloading $ARCH from $REPO ..." | tee -a "$LOG"
  python3 -c "
import os
os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET'] = '1'
os.environ['HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER'] = '1'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('${REPO}', local_dir='${LOCAL}')
print('${ARCH} DONE')
" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
done

echo "=== DOWNLOAD ALL DONE $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"

# Verify
for ARCH in GLA DeltaNet HGRN; do
  f="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/models/340M-20B-${ARCH}-hybrid-3-1/model.safetensors"
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    size=$(stat -c%s "$f")
    echo "${ARCH}: OK (${size} bytes)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  else
    echo "${ARCH}: MISSING" | tee -a "$LOG"
  fi
done
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/entrainment_gated_ft/download_models.sh && echo "SCRIPT_WRITTEN"
